name: B1 · Intermediário
description: Present perfect, condicionais 0 e 1, modais, used to, opiniões e conectores. Aqui você começa a contar experiências e argumentar.

flashcards.back: have/has + particípio (worked, been, seen). Liga o passado ao presente: experiência, resultado ou algo que continua.
flashcards.en: I have lived here for five years.
flashcards.syl: ai rév livd rír fór fáiv IÉRS

flashcards.back: for + duração (for two years). since + ponto no tempo (since 2020, since Monday).
flashcards.en: I've known her for ten years, since 2016.
flashcards.syl: aiv nôun rer fór tén IÉRS, sins tuén-ti-SIKS-tín

flashcards.back: ever (já, em perguntas) · never · already (afirmativa) · yet (negativa/pergunta, no fim) · just (acabou de).
flashcards.en: Have you ever been to Canada? I haven't finished yet.
flashcards.syl: rév iú É-ver bín tu KÉ-nâ-dâ · ai RÉ-vent FÍ-nicht iét

flashcards.back: Past simple: momento definido e terminado (yesterday, in 2019). Present perfect: sem tempo definido ou ligado ao agora.
flashcards.en: I went to Rome in 2019. I've been to Rome twice.
flashcards.syl: ai uênt tu rôum in tuén-ti-nain-TÍN · aiv bín tu rôum tuáis

flashcards.back: has been to = foi e voltou · has gone to = foi e ainda está lá.
flashcards.en: She has been to Paris. He has gone to Paris.
flashcards.syl: chi réz bín tu PÉ-ris · ri réz gón tu PÉ-ris

flashcards.back: If + presente, presente: fatos e regras gerais. If you heat ice, it melts.
flashcards.en: If you heat ice, it melts.
flashcards.syl: if iú rít áis, it mélts

flashcards.back: If + presente simples, will + verbo. Situação real e possível no futuro.
flashcards.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
flashcards.syl: if it réinz tu-MÓ-rôu, uí uíu stêi rôum

flashcards.back: Unless = if ... not (a menos que). Unless you hurry, you'll be late = If you don't hurry...
flashcards.en: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
flashcards.syl: ân-LÉS iú RÁ-ri, iúu mis dâ bâs

flashcards.back: should = conselho. must = obrigação forte/pessoal. have to = obrigação externa. mustn't = proibido; don't have to = não precisa.
flashcards.en: You should rest. You must wear a seatbelt.
flashcards.syl: iú chúd rést · iú mâst uér â SÉIT-bélt

flashcards.back: Probabilidade crescente: might / may / could (talvez) < must (certeza de que é). He might be at home.
flashcards.en: He might be at home. He must be tired.
flashcards.syl: ri máit bi ét rôum · ri mâst bi TÁI-erd

flashcards.topic: Used to e Hábitos no Passado
flashcards.back: Hábito ou estado do passado que não é mais verdade. Negativa: didn't use to. Pergunta: Did you use to...?
flashcards.en: I used to play guitar when I was a kid.
flashcards.syl: ai iúzd tu plêi gui-TÁR uén ai uóz â kid

flashcards.topic: Used to e Hábitos no Passado
flashcards.back: used to + verbo = costumava. be used to + -ing = estar acostumado. get used to + -ing = acostumar-se.
flashcards.en: I'm used to waking up early. I'm getting used to it.
flashcards.syl: aim iúzd tu UÊI-king âp ÉR-li · aim GÉ-ting iúzd tu it

flashcards.back: I think... · In my opinion... · I believe... · As far as I'm concerned... · To be honest...
flashcards.en: In my opinion, it's a great idea.
flashcards.syl: in mai â-PÍ-nien, its â greit ai-DÍ-â

flashcards.back: Concordar: I agree. / Exactly! / That's true. Discordar educado: I see your point, but... / I'm not so sure.
flashcards.en: I see your point, but I'm not sure I agree.
flashcards.syl: ai si iór póint, bât aim nót chur ai â-GRÍ

flashcards.back: Although + oração (início/meio). However, + frase nova. but liga duas ideias contrastantes.
flashcards.en: Although it was raining, we went out.
flashcards.syl: ól-DÔU it uóz RÉI-ning, uí uênt áut

flashcards.back: because = porque (causa) · so = então (consequência) · therefore = portanto (mais formal).
flashcards.en: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
flashcards.syl: ai uóz TÁI-erd, sôu ai uênt tu béd ÉR-li

flashcards.en: We stayed home because of the rain.
flashcards.syl: uí stêid rôum bi-KÓZ óv dâ réin

questions.question: He's not here. He ___ to the bank.
questions.explanation: has gone = foi e ainda não voltou.

questions.question: If you mix red and blue, you ___ purple.
If I ___ time, I'll call you.
questions.explanation: No if-clause da 1ª condicional usa-se presente simples.

questions.question: ___ you hurry, you'll miss the train.
You ___ smoke here. It's forbidden.
questions.explanation: mustn't = proibido. 'Don't have to' = não é necessário.

questions.question: I'm not sure where she is. She ___ be at the gym.

questions.topic: Used to e Hábitos no Passado
questions.question: I ___ play soccer every weekend, but now I don't.
questions.en: I used to play soccer every weekend.

questions.topic: Used to e Hábitos no Passado
questions.question: I'm used to ___ up early.
How do you politely disagree?
options: I see your point, but I'm not sure I agree.
questions.explanation: Reconhecer o ponto do outro suaviza a discordância.

questions.question: ___ it was raining, we went to the park.
questions.en: Although it was raining, we went to the park.

questions.question: He was tired. ___, he kept working.
questions.explanation: However, começa uma nova frase com ideia contrastante.

questions.question: We cancelled the picnic ___ the weather.
How long ___ you ___ English?
questions.explanation: 'How long' + ação que continua: have you studied.
questions.en: How long have you studied English?
